meta.note: All prices are ESTIMATES per night for a family of 2 adults + up to 3 children at standard rates. Holiday/school-holiday pricing will be higher. Always verify on the official website.

properties.name: Rumba Beach Resort
properties.description: Luxurious beachfront apartments overlooking Bulcock Beach in Caloundra — spacious 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments with full kitchens, rooftop pool, BBQ area, direct beach access. Stunning sunset views. Family holiday favourite.
properties.bestFor: Families who want absolute beachfront at Caloundra — the rooftop pool and direct sand access are unbeatable.

properties.name: Oaks Sunshine Coast Oasis Resort
properties.description: Family resort paradise in Caloundra — water park with slides, lagoon pool, heated indoor pool, spa, kids' club, BBQ areas. Self-contained apartments with full kitchens. Walking distance to Bulcock Beach and Caloundra town centre.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting waterpark fun at a solid budget — the slides keep kids entertained for hours.

properties.name: BreakFree Grand Pacific
properties.description: Spacious apartment resort in central Caloundra — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom self-contained apartments, outdoor pool, tropical gardens, close to Bulcock Beach shops and restaurants. Great value for families on a budget.
properties.bestFor: Budget-conscious families needing multiple bedrooms and full kitchen near Caloundra Beach.

properties.name: Mantra Mooloolaba Beach
properties.description: Stunning Mooloolaba Esplanade location — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments with private balconies, ocean or hinterland views, heated pool, walk directly to Mooloolaba Beach, Sea Life aquarium, and Wharf dining precinct.
properties.bestFor: Families who want to be at the heart of Mooloolaba — beach, aquarium and restaurants at your doorstep.

properties.name: Elouera Tower
properties.description: Beachfront holiday apartments on Cotton Tree Beach — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom self-contained apartments, outdoor pool, BBQ area, spa, sauna. Walk to Cotton Tree shops, Maroochydore patrolled beach, and river. Classic family beach holiday.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting affordable beachfront at Maroochydore with pool and full self-catering.

properties.name: The Point Coolum Beach
properties.description: Premium beachfront apartments at Coolum — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom luxury apartments with ocean views, rooftop pool, spa, full kitchens. Steps from Coolum Beach, park and surf club. Stunning sunrise views.
properties.bestFor: Families who want luxury beachfront at Coolum — quieter than Mooloolaba with premium finishes.

properties.name: Newport Mooloolaba Apartments
properties.description: Modern apartment complex in Mooloolaba — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom self-contained apartments with private balconies, outdoor pool, BBQ area, secure parking. Short walk to beach, wharf and shops. Great value for families.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting clean modern apartments near Mooloolaba Beach at a reasonable price.

properties.name: The Sebel Twin Waters
properties.description: Resort-style apartments on a natural lagoon at Twin Waters — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments, 8 pools including lagoon pool and children's wading pool, BBQ areas, tennis courts, kayak hire onsite. Walk to Mudjimba Beach.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting resort facilities with apartment freedom — multiple pools and lagoon kayaking.

properties.name: Belaire Place Motel Apartments
properties.description: Great-value motel apartments in Mooloolaba — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom self-contained apartments, outdoor pool, tropical gardens. Short walk to beach, wharf, and shops. One of the most affordable family stays in Mooloolaba.
properties.bestFor: Families watching every dollar — cheapest solid option in Mooloolaba with full kitchen and pool.

properties.name: Coolum Caprice
properties.description: Beachfront holiday apartments at Coolum Beach — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom self-contained apartments with ocean or garden views, heated pool, spa, BBQ area. Steps from Coolum Beach and surf club. Family-friendly and relaxed.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting beachfront Coolum without the premium price — heated pool and full kitchen.

properties.name: Sea Spray Apartments
properties.description: Central Maroochydore apartment complex — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom self-contained apartments, outdoor pool, tropical gardens, secure parking. Walk to Sunshine Plaza, Maroochydore Beach, and surf club. Great central base.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting a central Sunshine Coast base near shopping plaza and patrolled beach.

properties.name: Pelican Waters Resort
properties.description: Resort apartments on the Greg Norman-designed golf course in Pelican Waters — 1 & 2 bedroom self-contained apartments with lagoon pool, tropical gardens, close to Golden Beach. Peaceful family setting.
properties.bestFor: Families who want a quieter Caloundra base near golf and calm swimming beaches.

properties.name: Oceans Mooloolaba
properties.description: Mooloolaba’s premier absolute-beachfront apartments — full kitchens, heated lagoon pool, spa, sauna, and the Esplanade’s restaurants at your doorstep.
properties.bestFor: Top-shelf beachfront apartment living right on Mooloolaba Beach.

properties.name: Breeze Mooloolaba
properties.description: Modern luxury apartments one street from Mooloolaba Beach — rooftop infinity pool with ocean views, full kitchens and laundries, big balconies.
properties.bestFor: New-build luxury with a rooftop pool the kids will rave about.

properties.name: Novotel Sunshine Coast Resort
properties.description: Resort built around its own saltwater lagoon at Twin Waters — kayaking and paddleboarding included, kids club, lagoon-view rooms and swim-up pool bar.
properties.bestFor: Resort-style fun with free water activities on a private lagoon.

properties.name: The Sebel Maroochydore
properties.description: Apartment hotel a short walk from Maroochydore Beach — full kitchens, two pools including heated lap pool, and Ocean Street’s dining precinct nearby.
properties.bestFor: Apartment comfort near beach and restaurants.

properties.name: Rumba Beach Resort Annex — Kings Beach Suites
properties.description: Modern self-contained suites overlooking Kings Beach Caloundra — full kitchens, heated pool, and the free beachfront saltwater pool and playground across the road.
properties.bestFor: Quiet Caloundra base by the calmest family beach.

properties.name: Alex Beach Cabins & Tourist Park
properties.description: Self-contained cabins 200m from Alexandra Headland beach — kitchens, pool, BBQ areas and a playground. Simple, clean and right by the surf.
properties.bestFor: Cheapest way to sleep a family near the beach.
